name: GhostProgress
description: Themed wrapper around headless GhostProgress. Same behavioral props plus tone and size. Importing it loads the default stylesheet and scopes styles to this instance. Hand-written because the wrapper is a .ts defineComponent.

props.name: value
props.description: Current progress forwarded to the unstyled GhostProgress. Omit or pass null for the indeterminate fallback.

props.name: max
props.description: Exclusive upper bound forwarded to the unstyled GhostProgress.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name forwarded as aria-label on the progressbar.

props.name: valueText
props.description: Accessible value text forwarded as aria-valuetext while determinate.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic color intent. The default omits data-tone so CSS can treat a missing hook as accent.

props.name: size
props.description: Track thickness. The default omits data-size so CSS can treat a missing hook as md.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The progressbar element inside the display:contents themed scope.

parts.name: indicator
parts.description: The fill. Determinate width is an inline percentage; indeterminate motion is CSS.

states.name: indeterminate
states.description: Present on the root when value is unknown. Recipe swaps translation for a reduced-motion pulse.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-motion-easing-standard
cssProperties.description: Easing for determinate transitions and indeterminate motion.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-spinner-duration
cssProperties.description: Indeterminate loop period. The reduced-motion pulse uses the same period so it does not flicker.
